motionContract.intent: Warm compliment, bashful glance and tentative peek back
motionContract.primaryMotion:
Umi has just received an unexpectedly warm compliment. His eyes make a quick bashful glance down and slightly aside; the feeling gathers his head, chest and shoulders a little inward together, with the bent elbows comfortably carrying his two full rounded paws beneath the chin. A short living pause lets the compliment sink in, then he peeks back at his friend with his eyes first and a small supported head/chest recovery, pleased but still shy. Keep the expression intimate and readable, not an exaggerated bow or constant all-body squirm. The two attention changes are short ordinary-speed accents, about0.2–0.4seconds each, with different spacing and a comfortable breathing pause between. Do not stretch one little turn across2–3seconds. The whole body supports one emotion; parts do not take turns performing.

The two thick curled gray paws remain distinct with a small natural gap, backs toward us, supported by the same full white forearms. They follow the small shoulder/elbow accommodation without crossing, rubbing, interlocking or colliding claw tips. Keep the original short ivory nail tips and pointed gray/white fur borders; do not invent palm pads on the visible backs. Let a brief natural blink keep the two dark eyelid curves separate from the compact gray bean eyebrows, reopening the original blue star eyes. Preserve the small closed smile and reference blush, no balloon cheeks or extra teeth. Scarf tips and folded hood ear follow the SAME supported recovery with a small brief after-settle; the one cape stays weighted and draped, no wind-like side flare. Finish in the original shy pose and a compatible living breath for the forward loop, not a frozen ending or snap.
